notes.title: Version 1.05.124 Update Content
notes.notes:
[b]Update content of version 1.05.124
1. Added a new campaign: Battle of Changping
2. Added 8 new sublimation heroes and sublimation hero illustrations
3. Added the function of locking characteristics
4. Added endless mode
5. Added the function of automatically releasing one-time building skills and automatically releasing hero skills in the city
6. Fixed the problem of scientific research values ​​exceeding the frame on the main interface
7. Fixed some text problems[/b]

notes.title: Epoch of Guardians is officially released! 60% off for the first release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Thank you for your support, "Epoch of Guardians" is officially released! In the game, you will play the leader of civilization, develop technology, agriculture, military, etc., plan goals for the country, and lead them to glory!
A unique world will be generated every time you play!
In this process, you will also cultivate heroes unique to civilization, hold on to your city in the face of the continuous invasion of greedy enemies like a tide, and lead civilization to a more glorious future. I believe that when you use your carefully selected strategies to go through each process of winning more with less, you will have the most unique gaming experience.
